import sys
import argparse
import pdftotext

def extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path, output_path=None):
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        pdf = pdftotext.PDF(f)
    
    text = "\n\n".join(pdf)
    
    if output_path:
        with open(output_path, "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    else:
        print(text)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract text from a PDF file.")
    parser.add_argument("pdf_path", help="Path to the PDF file.")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Path to the output text file. If not provided, prints to stdout.")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    extract_text_from_pdf(args.pdf_path, args.output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

To address this issue and enhance the reliability of the test suite, it would be advisable to use pre-generated real PDF files with known text content for testing. Alternatively, a library capable of dynamically generating valid PDF files within the test environment could be utilized.
